candidateStatement: US Antimony's June 2026 quarterly filing reports that the Thompson Falls antimony smelter expansion was substantially completed during the second quarter, with a limited amount of assets placed in service.
candidateNote: USAC reports substantial construction completion of the Thompson Falls expansion during Q2 2026, with $4.1M of related assets placed in service late Q2 and about $29M of gross project costs still in construction in progress. This is issuer-reported construction progress, not a dated completion, full nine-furnace operation, proven production rate, or proof that all grant milestones are fulfilled. The $27M grant, $20M Montana allocation, $12.8M April receipt and roughly $39M company expansion budget have distinct bases.

primaryOriginal.claimLocator: Note 16 - Commitments and Contingencies, Thompson Falls, Montana Facility Expansion; Note 9 - Government Grant

disambiguatingOriginals.finding: DIBC approved three funding-performance milestones associated with $12.8M on March 25; cash collected April; this is not three physical plant commissioning milestones.
disambiguatingOriginals.caution: Financing accounting has a different state machine from M3 physical facility progress.

disambiguatingOriginals.finding: Company expected all nine new furnaces fully operating during Q3, an outlook rather than an achieved Aug 11 event.
disambiguatingOriginals.caution: An optimistic forward-looking operations forecast cannot upgrade construction progress.

disambiguatingOriginals.finding: Independent local reporting and original field photographs depict new facility processing and report seven of nine new furnaces operational, though not concurrently.
disambiguatingOriginals.caution: Neither the site-visit day nor full simultaneous operation or production throughput is established; this source is not in the canonical M3 citation registry.

disambiguatingOriginals.finding: Local reporting describes actual project work beginning May 2025 ahead of the September 2025 ceremonial groundbreaking.
disambiguatingOriginals.caution: Ceremony day and local article publication day do not establish a precise construction commencement date.

requiredReviewerDecisions: Read the full SEC original Notes 9 and 16 directly and determine whether the proposed construction-progress wording faithfully reflects the issuer rather than implied full commissioning.
Reconcile substantially completed construction, $4.1M placed in service and $29M remaining gross construction in progress without assuming accounting categories represent a dated physical event.
Check whether the $12.8M DIBC-approved grant milestones concern contract performance rather than separate verified physical furnace-start milestones.

Determine whether August 11 future guidance and August 27 independent partial-operation reporting qualify the specific Q2 observation without borrowing later event facts as if they were public in June.

Use the real current M3 worksheet digest, named reviewer and actual review date solely in gitignored adjudications; post-2026-10-09 reviews require separately authorized corpus-cutoff update before public-seed release.
